```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| class: watch
//| label: radialwatch90
watchRadial90 = {
  const radius = 100;

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [-radius, -radius, radius * 2, radius * 2])
    .style("max-width", "200px");

  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("r", radius)
    .style("fill", "rgb(10,34,58)");

  const ticks = svg.selectAll(".dec-second-tick")
    .data(d3.range(0, 90))
    .join("line")
      .attr("class", "dec-second-tick")
      .attr("x1", 0)
      .attr("x2", 0)
      .attr("y1", radius - 5)
      .attr("y2", radius - 10)
      .attr("stroke-width", 3)
      .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
      .style("opacity", 1)
      .attr("transform", d => `rotate(${180 + d * 4})`);

  const label = svg.append("text")
    .attr("y", 32)
    .attr("fill", "white")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-family", "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif")
    .attr("font-weight", 600)
    .attr("font-size", "90px")
    .style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums");

  while (true) {
    const t = new Date();
    const ms = ((t.getHours() * 60 + t.getMinutes()) * 60 + t.getSeconds()) * 1000
             + t.getMilliseconds();
    const millidays = ms / 86400;                     // 86 400 ms per milliday
    const seconds = Math.floor((millidays % 1) * 90); // Dec second 0–89

    label.text(String(Math.floor(millidays)).padStart(3, "0"));
    ticks.attr("stroke", d => (d >= seconds ? "#555" : "white"));

    yield svg.node();
    await Promises.delay(960 - (ms % 960));           // next Dec second
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| class: watch
```
```{ojs}
//| label: radialwatch100
watchRadial100 = {
  const radius = 100;

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [-radius, -radius, radius * 2, radius * 2])
    .style("max-width", "200px");

  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("r", radius)
    .style("fill", "rgb(10,34,58)");

  // 100 ticks = 100 cmd = 1 md
  const ticks = svg.selectAll(".cmd-tick")
    .data(d3.range(0, 100))
    .join("line")
      .attr("class", "cmd-tick")
      .attr("x1", 0)
      .attr("x2", 0)
      .attr("y1", radius - 5)
      .attr("y2", radius - 10)
      .attr("stroke-width", 3)
      .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")
      .style("opacity", 1)
      .attr("transform", d => `rotate(${180 + d * 3.6})`);

  const label = svg.append("text")
    .attr("y", 32)
    .attr("fill", "white")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-family", "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif")
    .attr("font-weight", 600)
    .attr("font-size", "90px")
    .style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums");

  while (true) {
    const t = new Date();
    const ms = ((t.getHours() * 60 + t.getMinutes()) * 60 + t.getSeconds()) * 1000
             + t.getMilliseconds();
    const millidays = ms / 86400;                    // 86 400 ms per milliday
    const cmd = Math.floor((millidays % 1) * 100);   // centimilliday 0–99

    label.text(String(Math.floor(millidays)).padStart(3, "0"));
    ticks.attr("stroke", d => (d >= cmd ? "#555" : "white"));

    yield svg.node();
    await Promises.delay(864 - (ms % 864));          // next cmd (864 ms)
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| class: watch
//| label: horizontalwatch100
watchHorizontal100 = {
  const width = 200, height = 125;
  const perRow = 50;
  const spacing = 3.6;                        // 50 ticks × 3.6 ≈ 176 px wide
  const rowY = 50;                            // row centres at y = ±50
  const tickLength = 10;
  const x0 = -((perRow - 1) * spacing) / 2;   // centre each row

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [-width / 2, -height / 2, width, height])
    .style("max-width", "200px");

  svg.append("rect")
    .attr("x", -width / 2)
    .attr("y", -height / 2)
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    //.attr("rx", 36)
    .style("fill", "rgb(10,34,58)");

  // ticks 0–49 above the number, 50–99 below, left to right
  const ticks = svg.selectAll(".cmd-tick")
    .data(d3.range(0, 100))
    .join("line")
      .attr("class", "cmd-tick")
      .attr("x1", d => x0 + (d % perRow) * spacing)
      .attr("x2", d => x0 + (d % perRow) * spacing)
      .attr("y1", d => (d < perRow ? -rowY : rowY) - tickLength / 2)
      .attr("y2", d => (d < perRow ? -rowY : rowY) + tickLength / 2)
      .attr("stroke-width", 2)
      .attr("stroke-linecap", "round");

  const label = svg.append("text")
    .attr("y", 32)
    .attr("fill", "white")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-family", "Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif")
    .attr("font-weight", 600)
    .attr("font-size", "90px")
    .style("font-variant-numeric", "tabular-nums");

  while (true) {
    const t = new Date();
    const ms = ((t.getHours() * 60 + t.getMinutes()) * 60 + t.getSeconds()) * 1000
             + t.getMilliseconds();
    const millidays = ms / 86400;                    // 86 400 ms per milliday
    const cmd = Math.floor((millidays % 1) * 100);   // centimilliday 0–99

    label.text(String(Math.floor(millidays)).padStart(3, "0"));
    ticks.attr("stroke", d => (d >= cmd ? "#555" : "white"));

    yield svg.node();
    await Promises.delay(864 - (ms % 864));          // next cmd (864 ms)
  }
}
```
